source.title: Naked eye visibility of Sirius in broad daylight
original_pages_visually_checked: B2 (PDF page index 1, observation setup, timed geometry and polarimetry)
B6 (PDF page index 5, Appendix A Regulus dawn)
source.caveat: Original author-hosted publisher-reprint PDF text and page screenshots verified in current read; direct raw-byte download unavailable. No original observer field notebooks or polarimeter instrument files acquired.

campaigns.site: Jacobus Kapteyn Telescope, Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma
campaigns.visual_method: UNAIDED EYE; subjects aligned gaze along the long finder on a telescope to locate the point; finder used as a directional aid, not stated to magnify the viewed star. Not spontaneous free-field detection.
campaigns.meteorology: Clear overhead; extensive cumulus clouds over ocean below observatory; nearby Tenerife upper air sounding 12:00 UTC and inversion layer around 1850m.
campaigns.polarimeter: 12-channel MPF photopolarimeter, sky near Sirius about 1.5 arcmin off target
campaigns.aot550_provenance: FITTED FROM NEAR-CONTEMPORANEOUS SPECTRAL POLARIZATION with KNMI DAK using LOWTRAN7 tropospheric aerosol shape, NOT an independent direct AOD measurement; fits surface albedo 0.35

campaigns.nearby_cue: Venus mag -3.6, Regulus about 8 arcmin away
campaigns.visual_method: No magnifying instrument; a cardboard tube (55 cm long, 6 cm diameter) acted as a sightline/stray-light baffle for the later sightings. Venus provided a bright angular cue.
campaigns.sky_conditions: Sun partly obscured by distant frontal cloud bank; intermittent target clouds and clear gaps; atmospheric airflow reported 20m/s at 06:00 UTC; local condition not representative of open bright twilight.
campaigns.atmosphere_source: De Bilt 00z radiosonde cloud-top estimate approx. 8 km, distant cloud front about 200km; not a matched calibrated aerosol profile

admission.critical_nuance: The 1988 AOT550=0.04 is inverse-model derived, not independent atmospheric ground truth. The 2012 +0.7-degree solar event was aided by a nonmagnifying baffle and anomalous sun-blocking cloud; neither is ordinary observer free-field twilight.
admission.field_protocol_implication: Before enrolling volunteers, register additional non-retroactive variables for bright nearby pointing cues, nonmagnifying tube/baffle or finder alignment, target-direction clouds versus clouds covering Sun, and transition of visual method between NO and YES. Preserve distinct exploratory strata; do not silently mix baffle/cue events with unaided free-field baseline.

safety: No protected Taylor/Ann Arbor/Jerusalem access, MYSTIC dispatch, ordinal67/68 use, model retraining, paid commitment or release. Existing V0 remains PREPARED/UNREGISTERED. Do not tune based on published historical outcomes.
